_doc: Family split template (lexeme_aligner.split_gen --family), Trans-New Guinea. Verbs carry suffix chains: tense/aspect/mood next to the stem, then subject person-number, then medial/final markers; a small set of prefixes (negation, object, sometimes subject). Nouns take case / postposition suffixes that render a source preposition. Slots give order and what each may render; forms are learned per language (grounding). No hand-made TNG reference exists (Kuni-Boazi, our nearest hand bundle, is Anim family): validated by the gold-free check only.
